$comment: Reviewed npm advisory acceptances. Enforced by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs.
Two-way: an unlisted moderate+ advisory fails, and an entry whose advisory is
gone fails so an acceptance cannot outlive its risk. Every entry needs a
reason, and the reason must be why the code is UNREACHABLE in the shipped
desktop app or why no fix exists — never that upgrading is inconvenient.
Added by audit 20260906 (C3), which found the gate disabled at
continue-on-error for a pnpm-410 problem that no longer reproduces.

GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.reason: Dev-server path traversal in the website's VitePress toolchain. Same non-shipped dev-server surface as GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.

GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm.reason: Windows existsSync bypass in launch-editor, reachable only from Vite's dev-server error overlay. vite@7 and vite@8 are pinned to the patched lines by package.json overrides; the remaining instance is vite@5 under website>vitepress, whose 1.x line requires vite 5 and has no patched 5.x release. Website dev server only; not shipped.

GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.reason: esbuild dev server, reached through website>vitepress>vite. Build-time only; no esbuild server runs in the app or in CI's built output.

GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv.reason: Windows % escaping in launch-editor, reachable only from Vite's dev-server error overlay. vite@7 and vite@8 are pinned to the patched lines by package.json overrides; the remaining instance is vite@5 under website>vitepress, whose 1.x line requires vite 5 and has no patched 5.x release. Website dev server only; not shipped.

GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.reason: Dev-server path handling in the website's VitePress toolchain (website>vitepress>vite). Not shipped: the desktop app bundles built assets and never runs a Vite dev server. Fixed by a VitePress line that supports vite>=6.4.3.

GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr.reason: Windows-only file read through esbuild's own development server (servedir). esbuild 0.27.7 is reached only through build and test tooling: Vitest's browser mode (.>@vitest/coverage-v8>@vitest/browser>@vitest/mocker>vite>esbuild, the path pnpm audit reports), plus server__content's tsup bundler and Slidev's Vite. None of them starts esbuild's server: Vite serves with its own, tsup only bundles, and the shipped app contains no esbuild.

GHSA-gfr2-rv44-r23c.reason: Not imported by the desktop app or server/mcp; reached only through website>vitepress (build of our own docs) and server/content>@slidev/cli (developer-mode content server, not bundled). The fix, 14.3.3, is inside the pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAge window until 2026-10-23; then raise the markdown-it override to >=14.3.3 and delete this entry (the two-way gate fails once the advisory is gone).

GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c.reason: No patched version exists (affected <=1.1.3, the latest; advisory lists <0.0.0). Reached only via server__content>@slidev/cli>...>gray-matter>js-yaml@3>argparse@1>sprintf-js, and js-yaml@3 requires argparse only from its own CLI (bin/js-yaml.js); gray-matter uses the library entry, which never loads argparse. Re-check when sprintf-js ships a fix or Slidev drops js-yaml@3.

GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw.reason: Editor CLI flag handling in launch-editor, reachable only from Vite's dev-server error overlay. vite@7 and vite@8 are pinned to the patched lines by package.json overrides; the remaining instance is vite@5 under website>vitepress, whose 1.x line requires vite 5 and has no patched 5.x release. Website dev server only; not shipped.

GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3.reason: launch-editor UNC handling reachable only from Vite's dev-server error overlay in the website toolchain. Not shipped.

GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.reason: No patched version exists (affected <=3.0.3, the latest; advisory lists <0.0.0). Shipped only via server__content>@slidev/cli (vite-plugin-static-copy>chokidar@3, fast-glob>micromatch), whose glob patterns are Slidev's own; the content server's watcher is chokidar@5, which has no braces. Other paths (globby, markdownlint-cli2) are dev tooling. Worst case is a stack-overflow crash of the local Slidev preview for a deck the user opened. Re-check when braces ships a fix or Slidev drops chokidar@3.
